title_zh: 确定港口贸易展板的材料范围

scenario.label_zh: 确定港口贸易展板的材料范围
scenario.goal_zh: 依据展览资料选择铜贸易实例，并约定注明殖民背景和记录出处

context_zh: 虚构地方史展览：工作人员依据给定的历史资料讨论展板，不声称描述真实港口史。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Aisha
sentences.text: This colonial shipping ledger is difficult to turn into a display. Where should we start?

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: With one commodity rather than every item. Copper appears in several of the entries.

sentences.speaker: Aisha
sentences.text: Would that make the panel too narrow?

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: Not if we use the copper trade to explain commerce through this port. The ledger gives us destinations and quantities.

sentences.speaker: Aisha
sentences.text: We also need to say who kept the ledger and that it comes from the period of colonial rule.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll build the panel around those copper entries and include the archive reference, without guessing who profited.
